model.name: none
model.note: The scored pipeline is deterministic: every decision is computed from MCP evidence and the MCP policy by Python rules. No language model takes part in any output that is submitted.

run.command: day09 run && day09 validate && day09 package --output dist/submission.zip
run.mcp_retry_policy: timeouts retried at most 2 times; tool errors never retried
